sv.title: Prinsessans prao i Finland
sv.summary: Prinsessan Estelle har praoat i Finland. Hon tillbringade veckan på den svenska ambassaden och med president Alexander Stubb. ”Det har varit en intensiv men fantastisk vecka”, skriver hon.

en.title: The princess's work placement in Finland
en.summary: Princess Estelle has done a work placement in Finland. She spent the week at the Swedish embassy and with President Alexander Stubb. "It has been an intensive but fantastic week," she writes.
